messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU queue length > 2000 in region east1-primary (pool: gpu-pool-e1). Throttling observed. Severity: page. Metrics: q_len=2147, avg_wait=12.6s, p95_latency_tokens=720ms
Sam (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Initiating triage. First glance: autoscaler didn't add nodes for last 18m. Starting runbook checks now.
Sam (oncall): quick snapshot: recent deploy 23:42 could've changed instance request flags. Also seeing API error 'quota exceeded' from cloud provider around 23:51 in autoscaler logs.
Leo (eng-runtime): I can pull the autoscaler logs, give me a minute. If it's quota we might need to bounce to overflow routing to avoid customer impact.
Jesse (eng-sre): Paging infra team to confirm quotas. @cloud-ops anyone oncall?
Mira (oncall-2): I'm up, taking secondary. Sam, want me to start the cross-region steer?
Sam (oncall): Yes. Plan: enable soft-steer from east1 to west2 for latency-sensitive routes (model: rdx-v2-high), keep heavier batches in east1-only. We want to reduce q_len by ~60% while keeping degraded SLAs for non-critical workloads.
Tanya (support): Notifying top 5 customers impacted by increased generation latency. Putting PS incident: "Region east1 capacity degraded; temporary routing applied".
Leo (eng-runtime): Autoscaler logs (snip):
```
2026-06-18T23:50:12Z autoscaler: scale_request -> desired_replicas=24
2026-06-18T23:51:03Z cloudapi: create_instance -> 403 Quota exceeded: GPU quota 40/40
2026-06-18T23:51:03Z autoscaler: failed_provision -> reason=quota_exceeded
2026-06-18T23:54:09Z autoscaler: retrying provisioning, backoff=30s
```
Sam (oncall): Confirmed. Quota block. That explains why queue kept growing. We need to reduce incoming accepted requests to prevent timeouts and degrade gracefully. Mira, can you flip routing to enable overflow? Leo/Jesse, prepare rollback path for routing change.
Mira (oncall-2): Running the routing patch now. Using internal steer API.
Mira (oncall-2): Command: curl -s -X POST "https://internal-router/api/steer" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"from_region":"east1","to_region":"west2","policy":"latency_pref","models":["rdx-v2-high"],"max_pct":0.6}' | jq .
Mira (oncall-2): Response: {"task_id":"steer-202606182354","status":"queued"} 
Jesse (eng-sre): I'm watching routing logs. If traffic shifts, validate KV cache compatibility for rdx-v2-high in west2. If mismatch we should only steer short prefix requests.
Leo (eng-runtime): KV cache is compatible; west2 has latest weights. We'll watch for increased token cost. Also pushing a temporary rate-limit for unknown customers to buy time.
Sam (oncall): Enabling short-term per-org throttles on high-volume tenants: patching rate-limiter config. Command: /opsctl rate-limit set --scope org --qps 0.5 --reason "emergency east1 saturation"
Sam (oncall): Throttles applied. Notifying support to update statuspage.
Tanya (support): Statuspage: "Partial degradation in east1. Some generation requests may experience elevated latency; failover in progress." Posted.
statusbot: Incident created: INC-2026-3221. Severity: P2. Link: https://status.redwood.example/INC-2026-3221
Leo (eng-runtime): Telemetry: 5m after steer task queued, west2 ingestion +18% for rdx-v2-high. east1 queue length starting to decline: 2147 -> 1389 -> 820.
Mira (oncall-2): steer-202606182354 completed; traffic shifted ~52% for targeted models. Observed p95 latency in west2 increased from 640ms to 810ms (expected).
Sam (oncall): Good. Next step: try soft provisioning workaround — create lower-priority preemptible nodes in east1 to drain shortest jobs. Jesse, can you request ephemeral quota bump with cloud-ops?
Jesse (eng-sre): On it. Raised ticket to cloud support: TB-8943. Requested temporary quota raise of +10 GPUs for 2 hours. ETA 35-45m.
Leo (eng-runtime): In parallel, I pushed an autoscaler patch to ignore quota errors for one attempt and fallback to smaller instance types for quick turn-up. Deploying to canary now.
Mira (oncall-2): Canary deploy of autoscaler patch started. If it succeeds we'll be able to provision smaller GPU instances (g4-small) to reduce wait.
Sam (oncall): Monitoring error budget. We are seeing timeouts on some orgs with large batch workloads; support flagged higher tier customer A with retries failing. Tanya, which customers hit hard?
Tanya (support): Customers flagged: AcmeAI, ByteScribe, and InteriorsCo. AcmeAI is seeing >10% request failures for long generations. Notified Sales Eng.
Sam (oncall): Escalating to Customer Success for AcmeAI. Include mitigation suggestions: reduce max_length, enable streaming, retry with backoff.
Mira (oncall-2): Autoscaler canary succeeded on small cohort. Initiating rollout to staging pools in east1. If that works we'll trigger to primary pools (low blast radius).
Leo (eng-runtime): Also found routing config had a safeguard limiting steer to 50% by default. I raised it to 60% to get more headroom. Patch applied.
Jesse (eng-sre): Cloud support responded: temporary quota +8 GPUs approved for 1 hour (TB-8943). Provisioning now.
Sam (oncall): Good. Queue is down to 412. Latency recovering: p95 east1 now 1.1s -> 820ms overall. West2 p95 stable at 810ms.
Tanya (support): Customers updated: AcmeAI accepts suggested retry/backoff. They requested an ETA for return to normal. I'll pass along when we have it.
Sam (oncall): Status update to incident channel: mitigation in place, routing overflow active, temporary quota granted, autoscaler patch rolling. Action items: (1) monitor q_len for 2 hours (2) confirm cloud quota reverts and autoscaler patch metrics (3) prepare postmortem.
Mira (oncall-2): Handing escalation to Sam for 04:00 UTC shift. I'll remain available for rollback.
Sam (oncall): Taking ownership. If anything regresses ping @sam-oncall.
statusbot: Incident INC-2026-3221 status: "Mitigated - monitoring". Updated at 2026-06-19T00:46:40Z.
Sam (oncall): Final metrics in this window: east1 q_len peak 2147, mitigated to 120 within 70 minutes. Autoscaler added 8 temporary GPUs (preemptible) + routing steer shifted 52% targeted traffic to west2, customer-facing error rate for top 50 orgs dropped from 6.2% -> 0.9%.
Jesse (eng-sre): Filing postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-3221. Will include timeline, root cause (quota regression after recent quota-friendly deploy), and remediation: automated quota alerts + pre-approved emergency GPU pool.
Tanya (support): Sending wrap-up to customers and updating statuspage to "Resolved - monitoring" once quotas normalize.
Sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leaving notes in runbook about autoscaler behavior when cloud returns 403 quota errors. Oncall rotation continues.
Mira (oncall-2): Good job. I'll add a short test to the CI that simulates quota errors for autoscaler to catch regressions.
Sam (oncall): Closing thread. Postmortem link will be posted here when ready.
